title: Post-Coronary Stent & GI Prophylaxis ICU Polypharmacy
clinical_setting: Cardiovascular ICU (CICU) — Day 2 Post-Percutaneous Coronary Intervention

patient_context.diagnosis: Acute Non-ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction s/p Drug-Eluting Stent (DES) in LAD
patient_context.history: Peptic ulcer disease with bleeding 3 years ago; hypertension; hyperlipidemia

active_severe_ddis.mechanism: Omeprazole competitively binds CYP2C19, cutting clopidogrel active antiplatelet thiol metabolite formation by ~45% and spiking stent thrombosis risk.

cdss_recommendation.safe_substitution: Replace Omeprazole with Pantoprazole (low CYP2C19 affinity) or Famotidine (H2 antagonist with zero CYP interaction).

title: Atrial Fibrillation & Dyslipidemia Storm
clinical_setting: Cardiac Intensive Care Unit — Acute Rhythm Management

patient_context.diagnosis: Rapid Atrial Fibrillation with RVR, Chronic Heart Failure, Severe Hypercholesterolemia

active_severe_ddis.mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4, causing 3- to 4-fold elevation of simvastatin plasma levels and precipitating acute rhabdomyolysis.
Potent CYP2C9 inhibition suppresses S-warfarin elimination, driving INR above 8.0.
Renal P-glycoprotein efflux inhibition doubles digoxin levels; synergistic nodal slowing.

cdss_recommendation.safe_substitution: Switch Simvastatin to Rosuvastatin (non-CYP3A4 metabolized); reduce Warfarin by 50% or consider Apixaban; adjust Digoxin dose.

title: Refractory Heart Failure & Hyperkalemia Triad (Triple Whammy)
clinical_setting: Medical ICU — Volume Overload & Pain Management

patient_context.diagnosis: Decompensated HFrEF (NYHA Class III), Stage 3b Chronic Kidney Disease (eGFR 38 mL/min)
patient_context.history: Hypertensive nephropathy, severe musculoskeletal low back pain

active_severe_ddis.mechanism: Dual RAAS inhibition halts aldosterone potassium secretion in impaired renal parenchyma (risk K+ > 6.8 mEq/L).
NSAID constricts afferent renal arteriole while ACE inhibitor prevents efferent constriction, dropping GFR precipitously.

cdss_recommendation.safe_substitution: Discontinue Ibuprofen immediately and substitute with Acetaminophen; monitor serum potassium closely.

title: Neuro-ICU Seizure & Serotonergic Pain Regimen
clinical_setting: Neurological Intensive Care Unit — Postoperative Management

patient_context.diagnosis: Status post meningioma resection, secondary generalized epilepsy, MRSA hospital-acquired pneumonia
patient_context.history: Major depressive disorder, neuropathic central pain

active_severe_ddis.mechanism: Linezolid is a reversible MAOI; combined with SSRI sertraline, it causes lethal central serotonin accumulation.
Combined 5-HT reuptake inhibition plus opioid-induced seizure threshold depression.
CYP2C9 inhibition raises free phenytoin while ciprofloxacin lowers seizure threshold.

cdss_recommendation.safe_substitution: Replace Linezolid with Vancomycin for MRSA coverage; substitute Phenytoin with Levetiracetam (Keppra); treat pain with Morphine/Acetaminophen.
